caption.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries.

equation_note.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、u(0,t)=u(1,t)=0。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256、T=.1。κ=.1、θ=.2。目的関数のh重みを含む座標転置です。
equation_note.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1], fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints, 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps to T=.1; kappa=.1 and theta=.2. Coordinate transposes include explicit objective h weights.

name.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint
name.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay

latex: B=I+\Delta t\,\kappa A_h,\quad Bu_{k+1}=u_k+\Delta t\,\theta b

note.ja: 後退Eulerの離散写像を実際に逆伝播し、接線・独立高精度mode解・block replayと比較します。
note.en: Reverse the actual backward-Euler map and compare tangent derivatives, independent high-precision modes and block replay.

title.ja: 後退Euler離散モードと時間厳密半離散拡散の参照
title.en: Backward-Euler discrete modes and time-exact semidiscrete diffusion references

assumptions.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、同次Dirichlet、κ=.1、θ=.2、T=.1。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256。目的関数はh重み付き終端誤差と指定二次正則化です。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data, kappa = .1, theta = .2 and T = .1. Use 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps. The objective has an h-weighted terminal error and specified quadratic penalties.

note.ja: 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
note.en: Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.

reference_note.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。
reference_note.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification.

method_note.ja: ThomasでB u次=u現在+dt θbを解き、Bの転置を逆順に解きます。16stepごとにcheckpointを保存し、1blockを同じ順で再計算します。full配列を保存・解放した後で別の所有期間を測ります。
method_note.en: Thomas solves B u_next=u_current+dt theta b; reverse solves use B transpose. Save checkpoints every16steps and replay one block in the original order. Serialize and release the full trajectory before the separate checkpoint ownership window.
